spec.description: A shop for trading cards in four rarity tiers. The coin is CARD. The creator loads sixteen test cards, four of each tier, and seeds the shop. After graduation anyone picks a card for twice the sell-back price. Sell-backs open seven days after the box was created: then any holder of a listed card can sell one back for its tier's price, within weekly limits. The list is fixed: no curator and no new collections. The last card stays. Buyers fees go to holders. Sellers fees buy CARD for the shop up to twice its seed; excess goes to holders. Test network setup. The cards are owner-minted test stand-ins with our own art.

spec.description: Five hundred little houses, living Rent Free in your head. Buyers fees go to the houses outside the box; the share of houses inside buys RENT and burns it. Sellers fees buy RENT and burn it too. Rent and property tax are jokes. Nobody lives in these houses. Every item has its own picture; traits change nothing about fees. BNB Chain test setup; no promise of value.
